integrity: Claim-to-proof and finite checker supplied; general theorem follows by a finite nine-template inclusion–exclusion identity and an all-n directed-cycle extremizer, not extrapolation from empirical samples.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three colours and full labelled simple K_{2,n} support; deletion-only distance for two unary dependence atoms under lax disjunction. No assertion for arbitrary graphs or alphabets. Self-review only; historical-priority limitations are described in the accompanying review.
title: Exact three-colour census and sharp deletion budget for a two-atom dependence disjunction
